items.title: Thom Yorke Tells Harry Styles He Wishes He Hadn’t Written “High And Dry”
items.summary: Hey, you know Radiohead's 1995 single "High And Dry"? Good song! Very pretty! Very achy! You could certainly argue that it's one of the most conventional songs that Radiohed ever recorded, but that doesn't make it bad . Thom Yorke may feel differently, though. Radiohead haven't performed "High And Dry" since 1998, which would certainly imply that it's not one of their favorites. Also, Yorke straight-up told Harry Styles that he wishes he hadn't written the song at all.
